subject.title: Web 控制界面显示 ou_xxx open_id 和冗长的 session key，难以识别

question: Should this issue be solved as one canonical session-label precedence path using binding comments before agent/account identity, or by landing the partial UI/account-name PRs separately and tracking binding comments later?
rationale: The current open PRs overlap but do not implement the full requested precedence, and choosing separate partial fixes can create competing display sources across Gateway and Control UI.

options.title: Unify The Precedence Path
options.body: Implement one route/session metadata path that preserves explicit labels, then configured binding comments or accepted identity names, then raw identifiers across Gateway and Control UI.

options.title: Land Partial Fixes Separately
options.body: Accept the UI formatting and account-name PRs as incremental improvements while keeping this issue open for the missing binding-comment propagation.

options.title: Defer Binding Comments
options.body: Treat binding comments as an unconfirmed product direction and close or split this issue after documenting the supported fallback behavior.

recommendation.title: Unify The Precedence Path
recommendation.body: Implement one route/session metadata path that preserves explicit labels, then configured binding comments or accepted identity names, then raw identifiers across Gateway and Control UI.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision cuts across routing metadata, Gateway session rows, and recent Control UI session work, where Peter has the strongest feature-history signal.
